audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Jayce five of seven stages including level 6 and two items, which contradicts both the 51.49% win rate and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: audits/top/jayce__akali.json rates level 6 4/10 for Jayce because Perfect Execution's two dashes erase his kite gap and the recast executes him, and rates two items 4/10 because Akali shrouds, combos and bursts his no-armour frame. Inverted, those are Akali stages.
audit.corrected: phases[4] flipped to Akali at 6/10 and phases[6] to Skill at 5/10, matching the mirror; the content win chart follows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'his ultimate changes the math too' — Jayce's R is a 6s weapon swap, not a power spike at all.
audit.why: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer is on a flat 6s and is available from level 1 in practice; the real level 6 spike in this lane is your Perfect Execution.
audit.corrected: phases[4] rewritten around Perfect Execution's two dashes and its executing recast, as the mirror states it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Shuriken Flip can mark your own smoke cloud and dash you back into it, and Thundering Blow is a knockback that displaces you out of a commit.
audit.why: Shuriken Flip marks 'the first enemy or smoke cloud hit' and re-casts to dash to the marked target — the mirror records the same fact from Jayce's side. Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 in hammer form and knocks you away.
audit.corrected: The smoke-marking exit is stated in phases[3].why and report[5].t; the knockback in dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Shock Blast 16s at rank 1, Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate 20s at rank 1, the weapon swap a flat 6s; your Twilight Shroud is 20s and Shuriken Flip 16s at rank 1, and Perfect Execution 120s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Get E-knocked' was described as 'burning it for tiny value'.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title, naming Thundering Blow and the Acceleration Gate.

edits.before: He pokes you out — shroud his combo, all-in. Akali wins the Shock Blast cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his poke and all-in him. Track Shock Blast before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his poke and all-in him. Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — that gap is your entry window.

edits.before: Shock Blast fired through the Acceleration Gate is his real poke — never stand in that gate line at all.
edits.after: Shock Blast through an Acceleration Gate out-ranges everything you own at level 1. Farm at Q tip and eat nothing.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Jayce's Shock Blast is down.
edits.after: Shroud blanks his hammer follow-up, but the ground-cast blast still travels through the smoke.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Jayce must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, yet he still holds the range — you need Shuriken Flip's 825 to reach him at all before your first item.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shock Blast's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Shuriken Flip can mark your own smoke cloud, so you dash in and then dash back into the shroud.

edits.before: His ultimate is only a 6s stance swap and he has had it since level 1, so level 6 is your spike alone — take it.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is your spike: two dashes erase his kite gap and the recast executes a chipped Jayce off missing health.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shock Blast's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight while his Shock Blast is still on its 16s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Jayce carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items each and it is a coin flip: you burst his no-armour frame, but one gated blast still chunks you first.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shock Blast (16s at rank 1): his main poke, and a gate makes it faster and wider. - Thundering Blow (20s): a knockback that throws you off your own commit. - Your Shuriken Flip (16s) marks your smoke to dash back.

edits.before: Q Jayce at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550, E-mark and dash in once Shock Blast is spent, then Shroud the hammer follow-up.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Walking the lane while a gate is down — the accelerated blast hits harder and from further out.

edits.before: Q Jayce at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip reaches 825 against his 600 hammer range, so it is the only way you get on him.

edits.before: Jayce misses Shock Blast (16s) — commit your full pattern.
edits.after: His hammer needs you in melee; smoke takes that away from him.

edits.before: Hammer To the Skies! leaps and slows, then Lightning Field burns you down.
edits.after: An accelerated Shock Blast is faster and wider — never stand in that line.

edits.before: Thundering Blow (20s) knocks you back and deals magic damage.
edits.after: Thundering Blow throws you clean out of your own commit.

edits.before: Hammer stance gives him bonus armour and MR, and his first cannon hit strips yours instead.
edits.after: He wins every ranged exchange, so your only plan is closing that gap and killing him.

edits.before: Shock Blast fired through his Acceleration Gate gains range, speed and damage — break the line.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip marks your own smoke cloud, so you can dash back into shroud after committing.

notes: Mirrored from audits/top/jayce__akali.json, which rates Jayce 4/10 at level 6 and 4/10 at two items; inverted, those become Akali 6/10 and a 5/10 coin flip, so I flipped both sides and both ratings on this page and on the content chart. That mirror also records a data conflict I could not touch: MC_WR_TABLES.jayce lists akali at 47.75 while the packet reports 51.49 over 1775 games, and this page's FAV / 8.5-of-10 framing was written against the higher number. WR tables are read-only for me.
